verdict.rationale: The evidence documents headless mode, CLI batch conversion and printing, and macro invocation on file open, but nothing about LibreOffice scheduling recurring jobs or workflows itself. Scheduling these one-off CLI runs from cron or Docker would be a host-platform or user-side workaround, which earns no credit. Scheduling is a fair automation question for an office suite, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
